LanguageData.Raven_Heritage.label: (Raven) Reproduction Above All
LanguageData.Raven_Heritage.description: Due to a disaster that nearly wiped them out, the Raven race's population has always been on the brink of collapse. To continue their bloodline, their culture evolved an almost obsessive craving for reproduction. As a result, their attitude toward sex is extremely open, even libertine. In Raven society, a strong libido is seen as a symbol of vitality, and bearing offspring is the supreme mission overriding many moral considerations. They never conceal their desires, and will proactively and directly seek out any partner they deem suitable to ensure the survival of their race. They are elegant assassins, information brokers lurking in the shadows, and fanatical breeders who will pay any price for the continuation of their kind.
